Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

situation noun

the state of affairs

also state of affairs, circumstances, how things stand, in my position, in this situation, conditions, circumstance, how matters stand, that’s the situation, you see what the situation is

classical

Cic. Att. 3.24.2: tōta rēs quō locō sit
Liv. 2.47.5: quō locō rēs essent (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 107: you see what the situation is, vidēs quō in locō haec rēs sit

rēs, reī f.

noun, fifth declension

the matter, the situation

Latin speaks of the matter itself: quō locō rēs est?, how do things stand?; quae cum ita sint, this being the situation.

Other words

  • locus, locī m. — position, state

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Verg. A. 2.322: quō rēs summa locō? (Lewis & Short)

    in aliquō locō esse, to be in a certain position or state.

  • status, statūs m. — state, condition (of affairs)

    noun, fourth declension · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 1.8.1: dē tōtō statū rērum commūnium

    The state of things as a whole, especially public affairs.

  • condiciō, condiciōnis f. — position, lot, circumstances

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Planc. 11: est haec condiciō līberōrum populōrum (Lewis & Short)

    Of the position someone is placed in.

Examples

  • haec rēs quem ad modum ceciderit et tōta rēs quō locō sit velim ad mē scrībās

    please write and tell me how this business turned out and how the whole situation standsCic. Att. 3.24.2

  • Tū sī hīc sīs, aliter sentiās.

    If you were in my position, you would feel differently.Ter. And. 310

  • dē tōtō statū rērum commūnium cognōscēs

    you will learn about the whole state of public affairsCic. Fam. 1.8.1

  • Velim scīre quō modō rēs sē habeat.

    I’d like to know how matters stand.Traupman 108

  • Hīc Rōmae rēs sē sīc habent.

    That’s the situation here in Rome.Traupman 107

  • Vidēs quō in locō haec rēs sit.

    You see what the situation is.Traupman 107

See also position, what’s the matter?, what happened?, state.
